9:00 ~ 16:00 | An entire day | - Regarding the schedule of O-ASAJI, please refer to the chart just below. - Only in the date 28 DEC every year, the opening hours finish at “end of O-ASAJI”. - KYOZO is suspending its opening due to the inspection of the decrepit building. Your kind understanding would be most appreciated. ### Schedule of Morning Service and Rosary Blessing ![](https://www.zenkoji.jp/wp-content/uploads/p_1_01_yoteijikan_l.gif)^ O-ASAJI Schedule (Enlarged image will be displayed by clicking this image) The **Morning Service O-ASAJI** is the ritual at the HONDO every morning. Its starting time is adjusted one minute a day according to the sunrise. In the left chart, … - During the term of the line goes down towards left: The schedule is adjusted a minute earlier each day - During the term of the line goes down towards right: The schedule is adjusted a minute later each day The **Rosary Blessing O-JUZU CHODAI** takes place 4 times a day while the Abbot and the Abbess come up to the HONDO for the O-ASAJI and go down. The first once takes place slightly earlier than O-ASAJI schedule. However, the schedule of following 3 times are not fixed, depend on the application status of the prayers. Anybody can join this O-JUZU CHODAI. Please visit at the pavement in front of the HONDO a bit earlier than the time when the Abbot or the Abbess passes by and wait for it. Neither booking nor any charge are required. ### Inner Sanctuary Admission Ticket #### An **admission ticket NAIJIN-KEN** is required for entering places below: 1. NAIJIN of the HONDO (the inner part with TATAMI mattress) 2. O-KAIDAN Tour 3. Zenkoji History Museum in the CHUREIDEN Pagoda #### The NAIJIN-KEN is available at the location below in the temple precincts. - Ticket issuing machine located at your right hand side from the HONDO main entrance - Temple goods booth JUYOHIN-JO just inside the HONDO main entrance - Temple goods office JUYOHIN-JO in front of the HONDO - CHUREIDEN Pagoda entrance NAIJIN-KEN **Distribution Charge** Adults and Students of University & CollegeJPY 800.\_Students in Grades 7-12JPY 300.\_Students in Grades 1-6JPY 100.\_Pre-schoolersFREE You can enter the temple precincts and the Outer Sanctuary GEJIN of the HONDO (the part with floor-board) in free of charge.
